title: Gray encounter in Catskills cabin with military and CIA observers

tellings.quote: and he sees all these military and intelligence people standing around.

plain: In the 1980s the writer Whitley Strieber is said to have met grays, the small grey big-eyed beings of many abduction stories, at his cabin in the Catskills in New York, and to have seen military and intelligence people, CIA among them, standing around watching. The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels this from Strieber's own account in his book Communion, and it would mean the government knew of, or was part of, such encounters.
